english.notes:
(i) Section 33(1) of the Immigration, Asylum and Nationality Act 2006 provides that this section applies to ships, aircraft and vehicles which are:-
(a) arriving, or expected to arrive, in the United Kingdom, or
(b) leaving, or expected to leave, the United Kingdom.
(ii) Section 33(5) of the Immigration, Asylum and Nationality Act 2006 provides that in this section:-
(a) "freight information" means information which is of a kind specified by order of the Secretary of State and which relates to freight carried,
(b) "police purposes" has the meaning given by section 21(3) of the Immigration and Asylum Act 1999 (disclosure by Secretary of State), and (c) "reserved matters" has the same meaning as in the Scotland Act 1998.
(iii) Section 33(6) of the Immigration, Asylum and Nationality Act 2006 provides that a requirement imposed under section 33(2):-
(a) must be in writing,
(b) may apply generally or only to one or more specified ships, aircraft or vehicles,
(c) must specify a period, not exceeding six months and beginning with the date on which it is imposed, during which it has effect, and (d) must state the information required, and the date or time by which it is to be provided.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: 51 weeks imprisonment and /or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Note:
Section 34(4) of the Immigration, Asylum and Nationality Act 2006 provides that in relation to a conviction occurring before the commencement of section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003, the reference to 51 weeks shall be taken as a reference to three months.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
